_comment: Dataset registry for the eye.jcamd.com warehouse. Add here first; refer by id everywhere. All sources free, no keys, no signups (house policy).

ercot_dam_spp.backfill_note: MIS doc list covers recent history only; deep history accumulates via the daily collector. --since attempts date-bounded doc queries and reports honestly what the server returns.
ercot_dam_spp.source: ERCOT MIS IceDocListJsonWS reportTypeId=12331 (DAMSPNP XML, hourly)

ercot_load_wz.backfill_note: Same incremental accumulation as ercot_dam_spp. 1-day publication lag.
ercot_load_wz.source: ERCOT MIS IceDocListJsonWS reportTypeId=13101 (ACTUALSYSLOADWZ XML, hourly by weather zone)

fred_gasregw.source: FRED GASREGW (EIA weekly retail gasoline, US regular all formulations)

fred_wti.source: FRED DCOILWTICO (WTI crude spot, trading days)

usgs_gauges.source: USGS waterservices daily values (00060 discharge cfs, 00065 stage ft)
